notes: Food for home consumption is exempt.
Not taxed (general rule; the state did not answer the 2017 FTA survey).
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
No local sales taxes (Ocean City adds a 0.5% food and beverage tax).
Maryland did not answer the 2017 FTA survey; personal services and motor vehicle repair labor are not among its taxable services (not re-verified).
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: Maryland has no local sales tax; the 6% general rate applies everywhere.

Alcoholic beverages, short-term vehicle rentals and some services carry other state rates; those are taxability questions, not part of the general rate. The Comptroller's pages still show alcohol at 9%, so the alcohol rate has not been confirmed from an official source here and is not used.
